body.label: Trigger
body.html: An ally within 5 units is targeted by an Action or declares a Reaction.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The ally gains +1 Defense against the triggering Action or +1 die on the triggering Reaction. If it is Rallied, it may choose both and then remove Rallied.

surges.html: A second eligible ally within 2 units receives one non-damage benefit of this Reaction.
Increase a Defense bonus granted by this Reaction by 1.
